 SERIE A ENILIVE | SQUAD LIST FOR PARMA VS. BOLOGNA
 Collecchio, 6 November 2026 - Head coach Alberto Gilardino has named a 24-man squad for Parma vs. Bologna on Matchday 11 of Serie A Enilive, which kicks off tomorrow at 18:00 CET at the Stadio Ennio Tardini.
 Goalkeepers 
 40 Edoardo Corvi, 30 Giovanni Daffara, 22 Simone Ghidotti.
 Defenders 
 27 Sascha Britschgi, 29 Franco Carboni, 15 Enrico Delprato, 3 Abdoulaye Ndiaye, 34 Diego Carlos Santos Silva, 37 Mariano Emir Troilo, 14 Emanuele Valeri.
 Midfielders 
 8 Benjamin Cremaschi, 80 Giovanni Fabbian, 76 Simone Lontani, 16 Mandela Keita, 47 Abdou Salam Konate, 41 Hans Nicolussi Caviglia, 32 Christian Ordoñez, 4 Vincent Olivier Sierro.
 Forwards 
 11 Pontus Almqvist, 7 Ousmane Diallo Thiao, 23 Nesta Elphege, 20 Matija Frigan, 9 Jose David Romero, 19 El Bilal Toure.
